integrity: Proof reconstructs strict convexity and KKT phase boundaries; finite program independently computes illustrative matrices, not an infinite proof. Source arXiv version 2 was read; earliest public date verified from arXiv version 1 bibliographic record.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight complete bipartite networks; unit-priced continuous gains, additive equal-intensity noise and inverse-trace objective only. Not independently validated. Unindexed equivalent A-optimal-design specializations remain a literature risk.
title: Reentrant concentration of continuous pinning gains on complete bipartite networks
